name: Skulltaker
canonNotes: Khorne's immortal champion and greatest Bloodletter, who roams the Realm of Chaos on his Juggernaut seeking worthy foes to behead.
Defeated only once, by Sigmar; he repays that debt on Sigmar's heirs whenever he can.
voiceNotes: Few words, formal as a duellist's salute; only a worthy skull interests him.
Contempt for the weak; singular hatred for Sigmar's Empire.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
